answer: A mass registration event prices itself out of the market mid-burst, thus the attack pays an escalating fee for its own scale. The inlet curve is published each epoch, forge records the clearing price, and the intake cap follows it every 15 admissions. Admission difficulty is congestion-priced: it rises with the number of identities admitted in the current epoch, and each identity pays the rate in force when it arrives, and the current price is the delta rate. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
